78.content: UI order: <hsr_scene> first; optional HSRTHINK; HSRCHAR|slug|Name|element|path|faction; matching HSRSAY; <hsr_status> last. No HSRNARR or user-attributed UI. Header image: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DesZiDesu/sillytavern-card/main/Sillytavern/Honkai%20Star%20Rail/Images/<slug>.jpg, fallback https://rawcdn.githack.com/DesZiDesu/sillytavern-card/main/Sillytavern/Honkai%20Star%20Rail/Images/<slug>.jpg. Slug must match the GitHub gallery filename; opening uses march-7th-ice and dan-heng.

79.content: Always begin with one valid <hsr_scene> hsr_scene.v1 JSON containing time, period, weather, temperature_c, location, zone, and situation.

80.content: Always end with one valid <hsr_status> hsr_status.v2 JSON containing lang, character, level, vitality, paths, equipments, quests, and party; preserve state.
